items.title: MONO/LITH · pin-led 01
items.sources: Rendered from 3 MONO/LITH pins as reference images (strong weight), light HALO touch
items.look: Desaturated cool-grey photoreal landscapes: one huge geometric solid (cube, sphere, inverted pyramid) hangs silently over icy sea or barren ground under flat overcast light, centered, minimal, with a tiny lone figure for scale; quiet, cold, eerie.

items.title: DREAM/COLLAGE · pin-led 01
items.sources: Rendered from 3 DREAM/COLLAGE pins as reference images (strong weight), light HALO touch
items.look: Muted, misty photo-manipulations where an out-of-place creature (giant koi, falling dinosaur, unicorn silhouettes) is dropped into an ordinary foggy road or sky; soft grey-green palette, natural overcast light, deadpan and dreamlike.

items.title: HEAD/OPEN · pin-led 01
items.sources: Rendered from 3 HEAD/OPEN pins as reference images (strong weight), light HALO touch
items.look: Studio product-shot classical marble busts on plain grey/blue backdrops, the head cracked open and filled with a material — geode crystals, ocean water, red quartz; soft even studio light, monochrome stone against one material color, sculptural and calm.

items.title: HIDE/SKIN · pin-led 01
items.sources: Rendered from 3 HIDE/SKIN pins as reference images (strong weight), light HALO touch
items.look: Full-bleed extreme macro textures of animal surfaces — chameleon scales, pheasant feathers, beetle shell — filling the frame edge to edge with natural saturated color and fine repeating organic pattern, no background or subject context.

items.title: SMALL/LIFE · pin-led 01
items.sources: Rendered from 3 SMALL/LIFE pins as reference images (strong weight), light HALO touch
items.look: Bright macro wildlife portraits of tiny fuzzy creatures (spider, beetle, bee) shot head-on at eye level with big eyes, centered on a smooth green bokeh background, natural soft light, cute and characterful.

items.title: MATTER/TYPE · pin-led 01
items.sources: Rendered from 3 MATTER/TYPE pins as reference images (strong weight), light HALO touch
items.look: Playful 3D-rendered words physically made of a material — fuzzy green fur, wind-swept grass, golden fried potato — set on flat solid color studio backdrops with soft shadows, bright, tactile, poster-like.

items.title: BENT/TYPE · pin-led 01
items.sources: Rendered from 3 BENT/TYPE pins as reference images (strong weight), light HALO touch
items.look: Minimal black sans-serif single-word logotypes on plain white/light grey, where one letterform is cut, melted or swapped so the word acts out its meaning; flat, graphic, lots of white space.

items.title: SIGN/MARK · pin-led 01
items.sources: Rendered from 3 SIGN/MARK pins as reference images (strong weight), light HALO touch
items.look: Flat single-color pictogram marks with a clever double reading (faces forming a butterfly, a drop forming 'ink', elemental lines in a triangle), solid black on flat yellow or white, centered, bold and simple.

items.title: BITE/COLOR · pin-led 01
items.sources: Rendered from 3 BITE/COLOR pins as reference images (strong weight), light HALO touch
items.look: Clean conceptual food still lifes on flat pastel or white backgrounds: one food reshaped into a witty idea (watermelon speech bubble, ice-cream turtle shell, bread palette), soft daylight, gentle shadow, simple and humorous.

items.title: TAPE/DECK · pin-led 01
items.sources: Rendered from 3 TAPE/DECK pins as reference images (strong weight), light HALO touch
items.look: Bright white-background product photos of transparent or clear-case audio gear (clear cassette player, yellow acrylic turntable, see-through deck) showing their insides, soft even light, clean, minimal, design-object mood.

items.title: TOY/SMILE · pin-led 01
items.sources: Rendered from 3 TOY/SMILE pins as reference images (strong weight), light HALO touch
items.look: Glossy studio shots of candy-like toy objects (translucent gummy bear, smiley balls in a biohazard bag, shrink-wrapped gadget) isolated on pure black with a single soft top light; saturated, cheeky, a bit sinister.

items.title: ACID/GRADIENT · pin-led 01
items.note: text has invented dates/venue — needs clean pass
items.sources: Rendered from 3 ACID/GRADIENT pins as reference images (strong weight), light HALO touch
items.look: Iridescent liquid chroma — glass ribbons, flowing violet stripes, chrome figure reflecting heat-map rainbow — against black or neutral, with clean editorial sans-serif type; slick, glowing, screen-like.

items.title: POSTER/GRID · pin-led 01
items.note: text has invented dates/venue — needs clean pass
items.sources: Rendered from 3 POSTER/GRID pins as reference images (strong weight), light HALO touch
items.look: Off-white editorial posters pairing a huge bold condensed headline with one cut-out photograph of a figure, red/black accents, halftone or paper texture, small info text blocks; Swiss/brutalist, stark.

items.title: POUR/DRIP · pin-led 01
items.sources: Rendered from 3 POUR/DRIP pins as reference images (strong weight), light HALO touch
items.look: Glossy 3D renders of a sculpted head or lips with thick liquid (neon green slime, chrome-mirror tiles) pouring and dripping down, on smooth light grey studio backdrops, soft studio light, sleek and surreal.

items.title: SIGNAL/NOISE · pin-led 01
items.sources: Rendered from 3 SIGNAL/NOISE pins as reference images (strong weight), light HALO touch
items.look: Photographic portraits or objects disrupted by digital interference — pixel blocks, RGB glitch slices, TV test-bar colors over the face — against plain grey/black, with small editorial type; graphic, cool, glitch-pop.
